review.brief: Validate RM4-tesla-add-vehicle-access-type (tier 1). (1) Boundary: only internal/tesla touched; no account/gateway/manualcharge/other-module edits; adapter stays stateless. (2) go-conventions: AccessType is a plain string DTO field, correctly NO Km()/Kmh() companion (not a distance/speed value); field placement/tag correct. (3) Spec coverage: specs/tesla/spec.md delta scenarios (OWNER decodes, DRIVER decodes, omitted->empty) match the implementation + test. (4) Test: offline httptest, no live Fleet call, no .env, no DB; covers OWNER and omitted->empty. (5) tesla-exploration rule: no _test.go added to raw.go/explorer; the raw-explorer sync rule correctly judged N/A (no new method) - confirm ListVehiclesRaw already exposes access_type via RawMessage. (6) Performance-Profile: no read-path/DB impact. (7) Design decisions D1-D4 honored. (8) Anti-gaming: tasks.md checkboxes and progress.json statuses truthful, no criteria weakened. Read the diff (commit 07ec32a) + the 4 artifacts, not the whole module. Escalate on any doubt (changes-requested) rather than approving.
